mapper.select: select count(*) as total, coalesce(sum(case when o.create_time >= curdate() then 1 else 0 end), 0) as today, coalesce(sum(case when o.create_time >= date_sub(curdate(), interval 6 day) then 1 else 0 end), 0) as week, coalesce(sum(case when o.status = 5 then 1 else 0 end), 0) as completed, coalesce(sum(case when o.status in (6, 8) then 1 else 0 end), 0) as cancelled, coalesce(sum(case when o.status = 5 then o.total_amount else 0 end), 0) as totalAmount, count(distinct o.owner_id) as activeUsers, round(sum(case when o.status = 5 then 1 else 0 end) / nullif(count(*), 0) * 100, 1) as completionRate from biz_order o where o.del_flag = '0'
select o.status as status, count(*) as value from biz_order o where o.del_flag = '0' group by o.status order by o.status
select o.category as category, count(*) as value from biz_order o where o.del_flag = '0' group by o.category order by value desc

select date_format(o.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as date, count(*) as count, coalesce(sum(o.total_amount), 0) as amount from biz_order o where o.del_flag = '0' and o.create_time >= date_sub(curdate(), interval 6 day) group by date_format(o.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') order by date asc

select coalesce(su.nick_name, concat('用户', o.owner_id)) as name, coalesce(sum(o.total_amount), 0) as value, count(*) as count from biz_order o left join sys_user su on su.user_id = o.owner_id and su.del_flag = '0' where o.del_flag = '0' and o.status = 5 and o.owner_id is not null group by o.owner_id, su.nick_name order by value desc limit 10
